Forum Seminar Alert! 🌱🦟

We are thrilled to welcome Naveen Kumar to this semester's Forum seminar series! Mark your calendars for an insightful presentation on innovative mosquito control strategies and their ecological footprint.

📅 Date: April 13th
🕐 Time: 1:00 PM - 3:00 PM (Presentation starts ~1:20 PM)
📍 Location: ESB 120

Talk Title: "Mosquito-Driven Pyriproxyfen Dissemination and Non-Target Effects in the Field"

Curious about how auto-dissemination (AD) of pyriproxyfen (PPF) targets cryptic mosquito breeding sites and its environmental implications? This study dives into the spatial dynamics of PPF dissemination and potential non-target exposure through plant nectar and other insects. Join us to learn how these findings are shaping the future of eco-conscious mosquito management.

Don't miss out on this fascinating discussion! We look forward to seeing you there.

#AcademicSeminar #MosquitoControl #PublicHealth #Entomology #EnvironmentalScience #VectorControl #ResearchInsights

2025–2026 UREC Sports Club of the Year. 
To many clubs, this might not mean much. But to us, this means everything.

We started this club almost a decade ago, and we’ve been through it all. From losing our affiliation with the rec, to holding meetings in a small house off 16th Street… to earning our way back while on probation… and now, standing here as Club of the Year. This isn’t just an award for this year’s team. This belongs to every single person who has come through this program and helped build it into what it is today. We carry your legacy. Your vision, not just to be one of the best powerlifting teams in the nation, but one of the best organizations on this campus.
